# LegatorOCR v0.2.0-pre.14 (pre-release)

Changes since pre.13.

**Window (not tested by hand — there is no GUI test harness; only the arithmetic and the settings are unit-tested)**
- Turning by 45° now works fully: the buttons and the skew slider add up; the slider no longer clamps the stored angle.
- Undo for the control box and the content box.
- Guide lines can be edited as vectors: drag the nodes, double-click a line to add one, right-click to remove one. A button places a 5 × 7 grid of points to drag on the working image.
- Fixed page sizes get two ticks, *resize to full width* and *resize to full height* (8 px of paper left at the sides); CLI `--fit-width`, `--fit-height`.
- The PDF password now sits after the author field and says it only opens protected input PDFs (output is not encrypted).
- Hover texts for invert negative scans (light-on-dark page scans, e.g. microfilm — not colour film negatives), drop colour, split at blank page and split at bar-code; the per-sheet split is now labelled “Split this sheet”, the global one is the default for all sheets.

**Command line**
- `--skew` and `--rotate` were silently ignored; fixed, with a test.
- OCRmyPDF option names accepted (`-l`, `--force-ocr`, `--redo-ocr`, `--deskew`, `--rotate-pages`, `--output-type`, `-j`, `--sidecar`, `--image-dpi`).
- ScanTailor `.ScanTailor` projects can be opened as `--project`.
- External OCR engine contract documented (docs/examples).

**Native OCR**
- About 27 % faster (AVX2 path, same output). On 6 pages, one run each, 2 CPUs: 21.0 s against Tesseract 25.9 s.
- Model unchanged from pre.13 (a longer training run is adopted in ROADMAP 4.17; figures there).

Not solved: no hand-verified reference text; no real stamped scans; Windows/macOS builds are CI-only; package recipes unsubmitted.
